visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-border for structural lines. Never use pure black/white borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for dropdowns, hover:shadow-md for cards.
visual_enhancers.backdrop_blur: Header and Secondary nav MUST have backdrop-blur-xl with semi-transparent background.

motion.tabs: Underline indicator should ideally snap or use layout animations, but CSS border-bottom is acceptable.
motion.sidebar: Hover state transitions background color smoothly.

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, links, tabs, search inputs).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-muted-foreground meets 4.5:1 ratio against background. Use APCA contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. ALL COMPONENT FILES MUST USE .js EXTENSION (e.g. Sidebar.js, Header.js, Layout.js). DO NOT USE .tsx.
2. IMPLEMENT the layout with 4 core regions: Header (Top), Secondary Nav (Under Header), Sidebar (Left), Article (Center), TOC (Right).

3. SECONDARY NAV: Create a horizontal tab bar right below the main header. Example tabs: Build, Design, Learn, Features. Clicking a tab must change the state of the active tab, and the Sidebar content must scope/filter based on this active tab.
4. HEADER AND NAV SURFACES: Must use bg-background/80 and bg-background/95 respectively with backdrop-blur-xl. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds.

5. SIDEBAR: Every page link must have a monochrome Lucide icon. The active item must have a blue left border indicator (border-l-[3px] border-primary) and blue text. The text and icons for inactive items are text-muted-foreground.
6. ARTICLE HEADER: Include an Eyebrow breadcrumb above the H1. Next to the H1 (flex-row, space-between), add a 'Copy page' or 'Share' icon button.
7. TYPOGRAPHY: Map Geist to headings and Inter to body text. Ensure tight tracking (tracking-tight) on headings.
8. BRANDING: STRICTLY stick to the #1588FC brand primary color. Do not use Replit's orange. Use this blue for active states, links, and accents.
9. DATA-TESTID: Always add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-item', data-testid='secondary-tab', data-testid='theme-toggle').
10. THEME: Ensure light mode is the default and looks pure and clean (white background #FFFFFF). Dark mode should be deep grey (#09090B), not flat black.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. The layout must feel extremely crisp, technical, and spaced generously like Replit docs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states, focus rings.
Subtle borders and crisp typography separate good from extraordinary.
Follow the exact spacing rules: generous padding in the prose section (py-8 to py-12), tighter padding in sidebars.
